note: Registry for ci:outbound-tracking. Every app/ and lib/ caller of sendEmail, sendBatchEmails, sendGmailMessage, sendCrmEmail, or Resend .emails.send must be a template or an exclusion. Render entries call the production builder, then the same wrap the send uses. Static is only the BPO letter, whose body builder is not exported and whose send renders a PDF. Exceptions are tel:, mailto:, and the Oregon Initial Agency Disclosure Pamphlet. Unsubscribe and /sign links that the instrumenter leaves raw are failures, not exceptions.
